# Freelanly — Personal AI Assistant for Vacancies and Projects Application
# https://freelanly.com

## About
Freelanly is a personal AI assistant that helps freelancers and remote candidates apply to vacancies and freelance projects. It discovers fresh openings (from LinkedIn hiring posts and company career pages), matches them to the user's profile, and drafts a tailored cover letter for each — with a second AI reviewer pass. The user always reviews and sends every application themselves, from their own inbox (Gmail OAuth or SMTP). Freelanly never sends anything on the user's behalf without their click, and it is not an auto-apply bot.

## Who it's for
Freelancers and remote candidates — many in Latin America and India — applying to remote roles and freelance projects at US and European companies. It covers both full-time vacancies and contract/freelance projects.

## How it works
1. Discovery: LinkedIn hiring posts and company career pages are scanned every few hours for fresh openings.
2. Matching: the user's profile, skills, and filters select the openings worth applying to.
3. Drafting: AI writes a short personalized cover letter referencing the job specifics and the user's real background; a second AI reviewer critiques it against the job requirements.
4. Review & send: the user reads, optionally edits, and sends the application from their own email. Opens and replies are tracked in a unified inbox.

## Pricing
Signing up is free; the first 3 applications are free (no credit card). PRO is $5/month: unlimited applications, a morning ready-queue of pre-written drafts, and a CV tailored to each role. Cancel anytime.
